senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.(b. h. פִּתֹם)Pithom, a storage city of Egypt.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 11a:19">Sot. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>ולמה נקרא שמה פ׳ שראשון ראשון פ̇י̇ ת̇הו̇ם̇ בולעו</he> why was Raameses named Pithom? Because the mouth of the deep swallowed every foundation as it was laid; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 (ref. to <he>פי החירת</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 14:2">Ex. XIV, 2</cite>) <he>לשעבר היתה נקראת פ׳</he> formerly its name was Pithom; a. e.
